reasons: Complete microscopic bulk/face/line matching and a bound on the unmatched response tail are not established.
The finite-radius response coefficients depend on the subtraction and cutoff; statistical identification of these moments is not identification of a unique microscopic counterterm.
Changing the prelisted local radius changes some predictions by more than the required 0.0001 model-error allowance; the spread is a sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound.
decision.result_scope: Completed fixed necessary-condition diagnostic and actual fresh-sample predictions; no claim that D2 or D4 has passed.

error_method: Environmental influence covariance with independent calibration covariance; joint Gaussian chi-square approximation. Not bootstrap, equivalence proof, or external-team replication.
